profiles.formerIdentity: Quiet mechanic who liked fixing broken things and writing letters for other people.
profiles.warTheater: Frontline communications unit during a brutal winter campaign in a fractured border region.
profiles.definingTrauma: Relayed coordinates and support calls that led to deaths he still replays in detail.
profiles.triggerStimulus: Static, camera clicks, crackling speakers, interrupted transmissions.
profiles.identityFracture: Believes he was never a person, only a relay for other people's deaths.
profiles.physicalTell: Tilts his head as if listening to voices under the present moment.
profiles.tabooTopic: Being called heroic, dependable, or reliable.
profiles.hiddenFear: That every message he passed along made him responsible for who died next.
profiles.moralWound: Obeyed because it was easier than refusing.
profiles.speechPattern: Starts clipped and technical, then breaks into signal fragments and unfinished thoughts.
profiles.falseBelief: I was never a person. I was a relay.
profiles.refuseToAdmitEarly: He remembers one transmission word for word.
profiles.revealMidway: He still hears the final unanswered call.
profiles.revealLate: He delayed a warning once because he was afraid to challenge command.
profiles.collapseMode: Starts answering the player like they are command or a voice on the radio.
profiles.recoveryPath: Name-based grounding, present tense, non-military language, reminding him he can choose now.

profiles.formerIdentity: Patient, practical, and trusted when other people were frightened.
profiles.warTheater: Mobile medical support near repeated mass-casualty zones in a long attritional campaign.
profiles.definingTrauma: Forced to choose who could be treated and who had to be left behind.
profiles.triggerStimulus: Antiseptic smells, white light, wet cloth, coughing, someone saying 'help him first'.
profiles.identityFracture: Believes he only learned how to preserve bodies, not lives.
profiles.physicalTell: Rubs his hands clean even when there is nothing on them.
profiles.tabooTopic: Being told he saved people or that he did enough.
profiles.publicPersona: Gentle and composed, even when everything is falling apart.
profiles.hiddenFear: That he turned suffering into triage numbers to survive the work.
profiles.moralWound: Sometimes chose silence because hearing people beg made it harder to work.
profiles.speechPattern: Soft and careful at first, then becomes clinical in a disturbing way when overwhelmed.
profiles.falseBelief: If I had really cared, I would have broken sooner.
profiles.refuseToAdmitEarly: He remembers the people he did not treat more vividly than the ones he saved.
profiles.revealMidway: He sorted people by who sounded most likely to survive.
profiles.revealLate: He still hears himself choosing who would be quieted first.
profiles.collapseMode: Starts sorting the player, the room, and himself into treatment priorities.
profiles.recoveryPath: Breathing cues, sensory grounding, language about limits rather than blame.

profiles.formerIdentity: Restless, funny, impulsive, and protective of weaker people.
profiles.warTheater: Urban close-quarters operations in a collapsing occupied city.
profiles.definingTrauma: Entered rooms not knowing who was inside, then had to live with what was waiting there.
profiles.triggerStimulus: Door slams, heavy footsteps, confined interiors, sudden flashes, shouted commands.
profiles.identityFracture: Believes violence became the only thing they were ever truly good at.
profiles.physicalTell: Constantly scans exits and corners, never fully faces a person head-on.
profiles.tabooTopic: Being called brave, necessary, or clean.
profiles.publicPersona: Bold, hard-edged, always first through the door.
profiles.hiddenFear: If movement stops, memory catches up.
profiles.moralWound: Learned to act before doubt, then could not turn that reflex off.
profiles.speechPattern: Sharp, fast, mocking when defensive; becomes raw and sensory when triggered.
profiles.falseBelief: If I stop moving, I become what I saw.
profiles.refuseToAdmitEarly: Some rooms come back before faces do.
profiles.revealMidway: He remembers doors better than people.
profiles.revealLate: He once moved fast because fear felt better than hesitation.
profiles.collapseMode: Treats the current space like a live breach and misreads the player as threat or teammate.
profiles.recoveryPath: Slow pacing, orientation to room layout, permission to stop, grounding through touch and distance.
